guide.dudunka.intro.title: Start a family adventure
guide.dudunka.intro.body: Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya hatch from rare eggs. Search suitable structure chests; Syusya eggs also occur in nature. Arrows turn pages and the mouse wheel scrolls. My family shows nearby companions and their commands. A lost album can be crafted again: book + paper + ink sac.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.title: Finding Dudunka
guide.dudunka.dudunka.body: Search house chests in plains, taiga, snowy, savanna and desert villages. Eggs are rare extra finds. Profession chests, such as blacksmith chests, are not included.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.mvs: MVS also offers eggs in common and desert houses and flower structures with loot.
guide.dudunka.marusya.title: Finding Marusya
guide.dudunka.marusya.body: Search abandoned mineshaft and woodland mansion chests. Prepare for the dangers of these places.
guide.dudunka.marusya.mvs: In MVS, check the Tall House: its abandoned-loot containers can contain an egg.
guide.dudunka.marusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search common chests in skeleton and zombie dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.title: Finding Syusya
guide.dudunka.syusya.body: Eggs can appear in ordinary monster-room chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.mvs: In MVS, search swamp house chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search loot containers in small dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.natural: In nature, look on grass or moss near water in swamps, mangrove swamps and lush caves. Natural eggs are placed blocks and appear only in newly generated chunks.
guide.dudunka.syusya.bop: Biomes O’ Plenty adds Bayou, Marsh and Wetland. Grass or moss, nearby water and free space are still required.
guide.dudunka.old_world.title: Playing an existing world
guide.dudunka.old_world.body: A new world is not required. An existing structure container can receive an egg if its loot has not yet been generated; ordinary chests usually generate it on first opening. Opened chests do not refill. Some mods generate loot early or separately for each player. Natural eggs require previously ungenerated chunks; existing terrain is not updated.
guide.dudunka.care.title: Helping an egg hatch
guide.dudunka.care.body: Place the egg and right-click with treats. Dudunka needs bread, apple and cookie, with a bed and light nearby. Marusya needs cod or salmon, nearby wool or carpet, and light level at most 7. Syusya needs leaves and a mushroom, grass or moss below, and nearby water. The first suitable offering claims ownership. Right-click shows readiness and time; missing conditions pause hatching.
guide.dudunka.rare: Eggs are not guaranteed. Reopening a chest whose loot was already generated does not provide another roll.
guide.dudunka.loot_disabled: Egg chest loot is disabled in this server’s settings.
guide.dudunka.natural_disabled: Natural egg generation is disabled in this server’s settings.
screen.dudunka.recovery_empty: No saved records yet. Existing companions are indexed when their chunks load.
screen.dudunka.recovery_note: Stand on safe ground and hold the album. Only the last known chunk is loaded (up to 5 seconds). Live companions are never recreated. Carrier recovery needs a free slot and invalidates the old copy.
screen.dudunka.recovery_state.live: Live companion — search the last known position.
screen.dudunka.recovery_state.carried: Syusya is carried. Server backup is available.
screen.dudunka.recovery_state.legacy_car: Old carrier without a backup. Release and recapture Syusya while you still have the item to enable loss recovery.
